hero.desc: Pharmatrack helps you quickly find nearby pharmacies where your prescribed medicine is available. Save time, avoid unnecessary travel, and get the medicine you need faster.

why.title: WHY PHARMATRACK
why.subtitle: Built for patients and pharmacies  communities
why.card1_desc: See which pharmacy have the medicine in the stock.
why.card2_desc: Find pharmacy near you with distance and direction.
why.card3_desc: Avoid unnecessary travel and get what you need faster.

how.title: How It Works
how.subtitle: Get medicine availability in just a few simple steps
how.step1_desc: Type the name of your medicine. We instantly show you which nearby pharmacies have it in stock.
how.step2_desc: Found it? Tap to see the location on our map. Get driving directions without leaving the app.
how.step3_desc: Got a code from the hospital? Enter it here. We will instantly show you the nearest pharmacy that can fulfill it.
how.step4_desc: Walk in to pick up your medicine. Have a question? Message the pharmacist directly through the app.

footer.desc: Pharmatrack is a health coordination platform. Medicines are supplied and dispensed only by licensed partner pharmacies.
footer.partner: Are you a pharmacy? Partner with us

cta.title: Ready to find your medicine?
cta.subtitle: Join thousands of users finding real-time availability, and saving time at pharmacies near them.
cta.pharmacy_subtitle: Partner with us to reach more patients and digitize your inventory.

about.quote: I have the prescription, but I don't know which pharmacy actually has it in stock.
about.label: WHY PHAMATRACK?
about.p1: In Rwanda, getting a prescription is only half the battle. The other half is walking from pharmacy to pharmacy, hoping that one of them has the specific medicine your doctor ordered.
about.p2: We built Pharmatrack so that patients and their families don't have to guess anymore. You can see exactly who has your medicine, how far away they are, before you even leave the hospital.
